review_comments.body: Is there a reason this can't be more strongly typed?

Not as far as I can tell: openai-python's `InputTokensDetails` declares `cache_write_tokens` and `cached_tokens` but not `cache_write_tokens_details` (not in 3.28 nor on main), and chatlas doesn't set a minimum `openai` version. The SDK keeps it as an extra field (a plain dict), so 3559ace reads it from `model_extra` instead of the getattr/isinstance branches, and the tests now build the usage through `ResponseUsage.model_validate` so they go through the same parsing path. Happy to switch to a typed attribute once the SDK adds one.
